notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/e164a1a17d00f033d561b13a49ab8c6a2e1e4209.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2]Hey everyone, and welcome![/h2][p][/p][p]This is the very first community post for [i]Darker[/i], so thank you for checking out the game’s page. I’ll be using these updates to keep you all in the loop as development moves forward.[/p][p]The most recent progress includes the release of [b]Part 8[/b] and [b]Part 9[/b], which continue to build on the story and expand the [i]Darker[/i] world. Each new part adds more hot scenes to an already large library.[/p][p][/p][h3]Update Highlights:[/h3][list][*][p]700+ high-quality renders (2k resolution)[/p][/*][*][p]15+ new animations (1000+ frames total)[/p][/*][*][p]3 major route choices, leading to 10+ different variations[/p][/*][*][p]A fully integrated audio experience, including music, sound effects, and NSFW audio[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I’m really excited to share more with you as things develop. If [i]Darker[/i] has caught your interest, don’t forget to [b]Wishlist the game[/b]. It’s the best way to stay updated on future releases and launch news.[/p][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/626253a15a80ad8e3f8c1ec701bee2efcef1f9e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/c25caa67491cff896871b3c8e47a5a53047493ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/6aa48786a042c3bc667b90d91569b0e902b317cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551517/8908ba15556f50f57bae6e52092f2de14f103f3a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Thanks again for being here. More updates soon![/h3]
